items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: you were with Pike Davis backing Bill Robinson

ctx.x: Well in the early thirties you played with the Berry Brothers dancing act. Then you were with Pike Davis backing Bill Robinson. We talked about Bill Robinson. And then it says you went on tour accompanying Norman and Arlene Selby, that's out of order there. Your show ended its run in Chicago when you were with Norman and Arlene Selby.
The place, the fair opened up, during that time. And this was, we were playing at the Follies Bergere.
